# WizIOT — Enterprise B2B Fleet Management & Telematics Platform

> WizIOT is an AI-powered unified IoT and telematics platform engineered for commercial haulage fleets, cold chain logistics, heavy construction machinery, EV battery management systems (BMS), and high-security cargo transport across Africa, Europe, GCC, APAC, and Latin America.

## Core Telematics Capabilities

- **Fuel Theft Prevention:** High-precision ±0.2% capacitive fuel probes, real-time siphoning alarms, automated fuel receipt reconciliation, and ATEX Zone 0/1 explosion-proof certifications.
- **Anti-Jamming & Security:** Multi-constellation GNSS anti-jammer detection, covert secondary trackers, and UN ECE R116 / ISO 26262 compliant remote engine immobilization.
- **Pharmaceutical Cold Chain:** WHO GDP and US-FDA 21 CFR Part 11 compliant BLE temperature sensors, real-time reefer monitoring, and automated audit certificate generation.
- **Video Telematics & Driver Safety:** Dual-AI DMS (Driver Monitoring System) in-cabin fatigue detection, ADAS forward collision warnings, and EU GSR 2024 Intelligent Speed Assistance (ISA).
- **EV & BMS Battery Analytics:** Real-time State of Charge (SoC), State of Health (SoH), cell temperature balancing, and thermal runaway prevention.
- **Heavy Machinery Telemetry:** IP67 / IP68 / IP69K ruggedized gateways, engine hour logging, hydraulic pressure sensors, and off-road vibration resistance.

## Target Global Logistics Hubs

- [Nairobi Fleet Telematics](https://www.wiziot.com/nairobi): East African inland logistics, ADAS safety, fuel reconciliation.
- [Mombasa Port Logistics](https://www.wiziot.com/mombasa): Northern Transit Corridor, anti-fuel siphoning, quad-SIM roaming.
- [Lagos Transport Hub](https://www.wiziot.com/lagos): Lagos-Ibadan-Kano highway, fake receipt detection, fuel fraud defense.
- [Johannesburg Anti-Hijack Hub](https://www.wiziot.com/johannesburg): N1/N3 highway security, remote immobilizers, armed response API.
- [Durban Port Cold Chain](https://www.wiziot.com/durban): Durban container terminal, BLE reefer temperature sensors.
- [Warsaw Anti-Jamming Center](https://www.wiziot.com/warsaw): EU TEN-T transit network, jammer-proof GNSS.
- [Dubai EV & Fleet Hub](https://www.wiziot.com/dubai): Extreme desert heat BMS analytics, ATEX tanker sensors.
- [Barcelona Logistics Corridor](https://www.wiziot.com/barcelona): AI route dispatching, driver safety scoring.
- [Mexico City Anti-Theft Hub](https://www.wiziot.com/mexico-city): NAFTA highway cargo security, remote engine cut-off.
- [São Paulo Mercosur Hub](https://www.wiziot.com/sao-paulo): Dual-AI DMS video telematics, cold chain compliance.
- [Bogotá Mountain Haulage](https://www.wiziot.com/bogota): IP67 rugged trackers, volumetric fuel probes.
- [Singapore Cross-Border Corridor](https://www.wiziot.com/singapore): Causeway tracking, multi-SIM roaming.
